children: may fall into a range of $3,442-$3,474 per ounce, based on a projection analysis.

The metal has briefly pierced below $3,526, the 400% projection level of a downtrend from $4,067. The projection analysis suggests a further fall into the range formed by the 461.8% and the 438.2% levels.

Immediate resistance is at $3,577, a break above which may lead to a weak gain into $3,609-$3,629 range. On the daily chart, a big wave C from $4,694 is unfolding toward its 100% projection level of $3,053, as it has travelled far below its 61.8% level of $3,680.
Bearish momentum looks extremely strong, as there has not been a single white candle on the downtrend from $4,148. The market seems to be experiencing a small crash.
